title: COVID-19 Outcome Prediction
description: A group project of 4 comparing machine learning models, including a neural network, to predict COVID-19 hospitalisation and mortality from pre-existing conditions using a large Mexican government dataset.
content: Group project of 4; compared KNN, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and Neural Network on 600k+ patient records
Performed data cleaning, feature engineering, and class imbalance handling with SMOTE and class weighting
Tuned hyperparameters via grid search and nested cross-validation, evaluating with precision, recall, and F1-score
Authored ACL-formatted research report analysing feature importance and model performance for clinical triage

Applied read/write locks to ensure thread-safe concurrent access
Developed GUI with Swing library for client-side interaction
Implemented JSON for data transmission and persistent storage
